statement: A Ukrainian drone or missile strike causes fire or damage at an oil refinery inside internationally recognized Russian territory between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-08, acknowledged by a Russian official.
resolution: Resolves true if Reuters or AP reports a Russian governor, ministry, or company official acknowledging fire or damage at a refinery inside Russia from a Ukrainian strike occurring between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-08.
failure_condition: No oil refinery inside internationally recognized Russian territory is set on fire or damaged by a Ukrainian strike between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-08.

statement: The United States and Iran each publicly confirm a bilateral ceasefire or truce that takes effect between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Resolves true if Reuters and AP both report that the US and Iranian governments each confirmed a bilateral ceasefire or truce taking effect between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: No ceasefire or truce confirmed by both the US and Iranian governments takes effect between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-30.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its meeting concluding on 2026-10-28, lifting the upper limit above 4.00 percent. Reference: target range 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: Resolves true if FRED series DFEDTARU, the federal funds target range upper limit, reads above 4.00 for 2026-10-29 following the decision announced 2026-10-28. Reference: 4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The FOMC holds or lowers the target range at the meeting concluding 2026-10-28, leaving the upper limit at or below 4.00 percent.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield recorded for 2026-12-31 is at or above 5.25 percent. Reference: 5.10 percent on the packet date.
resolution: Resolves true if FRED series DGS10, the 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield, shows a value at or above 5.25 for 2026-12-31. Reference: 5.10 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield recorded for 2026-12-31 is below 5.25 percent.

statement: CISA adds a BeyondTrust vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-30, following the exploited Remote Support zero-day patched in October 2026.
resolution: Resolves true if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains an entry with vendorProject BeyondTrust and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-30 inclusive; otherwise false.
failure_condition: CISA adds no BeyondTrust vulnerability to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-30.

statement: CISA adds CVE-2026-99999, the Linux kernel guest-to-host flaw publicized as PwnEscape, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-16 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: Resolves true if the CISA KEV catalog JSON lists CVE-2026-99999 with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-16 and 2027-01-15 inclusive; otherwise false.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-99999 is not added to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-16 and 2027-01-15.

statement: Edi Rama resigns or announces his resignation as Prime Minister of Albania, loses a parliamentary confidence vote, or is replaced, between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: Resolves true if Reuters or AP reports that Edi Rama resigned or announced his resignation as Prime Minister, lost a parliamentary confidence vote, or was replaced, between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: Edi Rama remains Prime Minister of Albania through 2026-12-31 without resigning, announcing a resignation, losing a confidence vote, or being replaced.

statement: James Talarico receives the most votes in the Texas US Senate general election held on 2026-11-03, defeating Ken Paxton.
resolution: Resolves true if Texas Secretary of State returns available at the deadline show Talarico with the most votes for US Senate in the 2026-11-03 general election.
failure_condition: Talarico does not receive the most votes in the 2026-11-03 Texas US Senate general election.

statement: Federal prosecutors file an indictment or information in the criminal case against the Saudi national OpenAI engineer charged with bugging an OpenAI conference room, between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: Resolves true if the PACER or CourtListener docket in the federal case over the OpenAI conference-room bugging shows an indictment or information filed between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-13.
failure_condition: No indictment or information is filed in the federal case against the Saudi national charged with bugging an OpenAI conference room between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-13.

statement: At least one earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or greater occurs anywhere in the world between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-15 UTC.
resolution: Resolves true if the USGS ComCat catalog, queried at the deadline, lists at least one event of magnitude 7.0 or greater with origin time between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-15 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or greater occurs anywhere in the world between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-15 UTC.
